title: Bounded reusable phases on incumbent Taskplane authorities
summary: Evolve incumbent Taskplane authorities into one shared phase-agent runtime: each stateless Product, Design, Plan, Build, Evaluate, Engineering, and Retro agent receives a sealed package and a declarative phase-definition plus skill, while the orchestrator alone owns dispatch, evaluation, continuation, gates, persistence, and progression. Preserve the actual-producer J0/J7 journeys, independently parameterized negative proofs, branch delivery, telemetry seal, and publication separation; add governed knowledge updates and Taskplane-owned nonce receipts without adding a second coordinator or store.

current_state.summary: The Taskplane 2.19.0 baseline already has source graph/decomposition, plan topology, exact selector and wiring closure, immutable stage values and handoff, RunStore replay/journaling, delivery ports and host observations, typed evaluation and canonical review policy, Build quality, durable run artifacts, terminal metrics/Retro, and protected-main release evidence. The active delta is to close their production connections and contracts for bounded source coverage, all seams, complete phase results, recovery, native observation, many-to-many acceptance, conformance, privacy-safe telemetry, and real finalization. The checked-in R-0002 Design and test strategy are historical and non-authoritative. Amendment A1 adds one disclosed thin runtime facade, declarative phase definitions, governed knowledge updates, and Taskplane-owned nonce observation while preserving incumbent lifecycle, store, graph, review, telemetry, and release authorities.

alternatives.description: Replace the current lifecycle and phase composition with a new coordinator, schema family, and migration layer.

alternatives.name: Patch each failing caller independently
alternatives.description: Add local fixes at current call sites without one complete phase-result and continuation contract.

costs: Retains divergent progression and refusal decisions
Allows fixture-repaired tests to pass while production connections remain broken
Cannot prove one active owner or complete successor packages
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Only as a temporary compatibility adapter with an explicit inactive-by condition and sealed input/output bindings.

decision: Keep incumbent contract evolution as the selected approach. Add one explicitly thin taskplane/agent_runtime.py facade that composes RunStore, delivery ports, producer observation, telemetry, and review evidence but owns no policy, persistence, or progression. Phase behavior is data in phase-definition/v1 plus a skill; knowledge is a sealed fingerprinted input and gated knowledge-update/v1 output; loop.py remains the sole continuation owner and hardcodes no phase list.

Identical bindings require an identical knowledge fingerprint; a changed knowledge fingerprint is changed input and is refused under the same operation identity.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: tp graph scan --strict and tp loop next

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC02 Dependency-derived tasks and complete seams: Connected impacted subgraphs determine task ownership/order; extensions are verified before expansion. Each cut edge/runtime seam has exact nodes/symbols, schema/version, cardinality, both owners, direction/order, distinct positive/severed selectors, and source/graph/requirement/Design/Plan/candidate provenance. Verification: Public readiness rejects omitted nodes/edges, orphan/duplicate producers or consumers, wrong direction/order, unowned rows, and stale/incomplete bindings.
acceptance_map.design_element: Connected impacted subgraphs drive task ownership and order; cross-task-seam-manifest-v1 closes every cut edge/runtime seam with endpoints, symbols, schema/version, cardinality, owners, direction/order, positive/severed selectors, and full provenance.
acceptance_map.validation: Public Plan readiness rejects omitted or stale nodes/edges, orphan or duplicate endpoints, wrong order/direction, unowned rows, unverified extensions, and incomplete bindings.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: tp loop gate pass at Plan readiness

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC03 Integrated realized conformance: Proposed overlays remain distinct from integrated as-built truth. Conformance detects added, removed/missing, changed, reversed, stale, and unexpected seams, including separately passing task diffs with a shared-contract mismatch. Verification: Engineering cannot approve before consuming current conformance and all seam proofs; overlay identity swaps or removed evidence bindings must block the public result.
acceptance_map.design_element: realized-seam-conformance-v1 compares the approved overlay with the combined candidate while leaving both as distinct artifacts; Engineering consumes every seam proof and an empty drift list.
acceptance_map.validation: Added, missing, changed, reversed, stale, unexpected, shared-contract mismatch, overlay swap, and removed-binding cases all block sign-off.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: tp review collect and Engineering sign-off

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC04 Faithful production-boundary proof: Every required worker/task/phase/runtime seam is proven using actual upstream production output and a distinct one-edge severance that makes the same public behavior fail. Verification: Reject missing, stale, foreign, multi-edge, ceremonial, or non-failing severance and consumer-only fabricated boundary claims; missing/unexecutable required runtime probes remain blocking gaps.
acceptance_map.design_element: Wiring closure executes each seam with actual upstream production output and registers a distinct one-edge mutation checkout whose severance must fail the same public behavior.
acceptance_map.validation: Missing, stale, foreign, multi-edge, ceremonial, non-failing, consumer-fabricated, or unavailable runtime proof stays blocking.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Build quality and Review seam proof collection

review_fixture_bypass_detection.rule: Test-design review must inspect the changed test AST/dataflow and producer-consumer evidence to identify arbitrary construction, insertion, monkeypatching, copying, or mutation of a predecessor artifact at a boundary claimed as integration/end-to-end evidence. Legitimate isolated consumer fixtures are allowed only when labeled consumer-unit and are ineligible for boundary/journey proof.

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC05 Standalone review and compatibility: Review without Plan derives current source/diff seams without inventing Plan authority, and labels declared/derived, partial, timed-out, unsupported, and truncated coverage. Eligible historical graph/evaluation-evidence/wiring records have deterministic migration or revalidation. Verification: Standalone and historical-generation fixtures preserve originals and reject a second graph, seam, or evidence authority.
acceptance_map.design_element: standalone-review-seams-v1 derives seams from bounded current source/diff, labels coverage status, and routes eligible historical graph/evidence/wiring records through deterministic adapters and append-only revalidation.
acceptance_map.validation: Standalone Review succeeds without Plan authority; partial/timed-out/unsupported/truncated and historical cases remain explicit and a second authority is rejected.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: tp review start without Plan

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC06 Entry, native capability, and identity: Supported CLI/native launchers preserve selected valid engine, arguments, contract, and enforcement; absent/invalid/ambiguous candidates fail before effects. Host capability precedes readiness; runs/replacement attempts have unique native identities, children bind owner attempts, and exact replay retains identity. Verification: Verify launcher/capability cases, a fresh real native spawn, foreign/broken identity refusals without widened authority, and duplicate events converging through one effective observation owner.
acceptance_map.design_element: CLI/native entry validates one installed engine and capability before effects; phase-host-dispatch-v1 binds unique run/replacement identity, child-owner identity, exact replay, and duplicate-event convergence to one observation owner.
acceptance_map.validation: Ordinary and native entry cases preserve arguments/contract/enforcement; absent/invalid/ambiguous engine and broken/foreign identity refuse before effects.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: tp CLI and native hook dispatch

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC07 C: substantive review admissibility: Canonical finding classification/blocking policy follows provenance validation. Pass labels cannot override policy-blocking unresolved findings or missing evidence; legitimate non-blocking debt/observations remain visible. Resolution needs current linked evidence. Verification: Contradictory public collection fixtures yield equal decisions for equal applicable classifications; append revalidation of relied-on historical passes, preserve originals, and mark unavailable retained evidence unverified.
acceptance_map.design_element: phase-review-collection-v1 validates identity and bytes, then applies the one canonical finding classification/blocking policy; resolutions require current linked evidence and historical revalidation is append-only. The evaluated phase agent's working lenses are isolated from the orchestrator-owned evaluator lens set.
acceptance_map.validation: A valid reported pass with a policy blocker or missing evidence is blocked equally across consumers; non-blocking debt stays visible and unavailable history stays unverified. The evaluator sealed package must omit the evaluated agent's working-lens configuration and bind an orchestrator-issued evaluation-lens-set fingerprint.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: tp review collect and loop submit/gate

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC08 E: truthful authorized recovery: Refusals preserve safe reason, phase/attempt, committed/observed/pending/uncertain effects, permitted continuation/prerequisites, and same-versus-replacement semantics. Missing terminal evidence names observation/wait/reconciliation. Verification: Public failures distinguish wait, artifact correction, setup repair, and authority request; execution rechecks authority, unchanged retry preserves identity/completed work, repeated identical failure stops without progress, and legitimate waits use a named event mechanism.
acceptance_map.design_element: phase-progress and phase-pickup receipts preserve safe reason, attempt, committed/observed/pending/uncertain effects, prerequisites, exact continuation, replacement semantics, event wait, authority recheck, and non-progress stop. agent-runtime/v1 emits budget_exhausted and lifecycle_api_attempt as terminal refusals with recorded effects and recovery. Leases, deadlines, heartbeat, fencing, and retry class are attempt-bound; retry is same-attempt only before effects or when proven effect-free, otherwise replacement requires reconciliation and a higher fence.
acceptance_map.validation: Public failures distinguish wait, artifact correction, setup repair, and authority; unchanged retry preserves work/identity and the third identical no-progress state holds without relaunch. Budget exhaustion leaves no lock and produces phase-pickup-result/v1 replacement-or-hold semantics; lifecycle API attempts are refused before effect. Lease expiry never proves cancellation; stale fences, post-effect same-attempt retry, unfenced replacement, and replacement before reconciliation are independently refused.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: loop next/submit/gate/resolve and pickup

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC09 A: complete producer result: Normal quality-enabled Design seals actual strategy bytes, all required produced/inherited artifacts, accessible evidence, and applicable quality authority. Fresh Plan and Build consume only the package through public interfaces. Verification: Remove, alter, or stale required artifacts and require a specific producer-completion or successor-admission refusal; no predecessor runtime access or inserted artifact, receipt, or permission repairs the production connection.
acceptance_map.design_element: stage-handoff/v2 seals actual selected strategy bytes, every required produced/inherited artifact, accessible evidence, applicable quality authority, unresolved issues, and exact continuation as the only fresh successor input.
acceptance_map.validation: Fresh Plan/Build consume the production package; removal, alteration, or staleness of each required item blocks producer completion or successor admission without fixture repair.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Design terminalization to fresh Plan and Build

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC10 B: recoverable attempts: Owner/reviewer setup/pickup reconcile every required record before readiness. Same-operation replay repairs setup or returns the valid prior result, while changed input under the identity is refused. Verification: Parameterize relevant phases/roles with fault injection at local persistence and external-effect boundaries; reconcile uncertain host work before another launch, report unavailable reconciliation precisely, and make no exactly-once remote claim.
acceptance_map.design_element: One RunStore-backed pickup/reconciliation path serves owner/reviewer and applicable phases, validating every required record and reconciling uncertain external work before readiness or relaunch.
acceptance_map.validation: Fault injection at each persistence/effect seam never yields false readiness; same-operation replay repairs/returns prior result, changed input refuses, and unavailable host reconciliation blocks.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: phase start/pickup

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC11 D: contributions and acceptance: Many-to-many task/criterion contributions support several exact proofs and separately required joint integration evidence. Accountable acceptance ownership does not exclude contributors; task completion is distinct from acceptance. Verification: Public Plan/Build/acceptance cases block missing contributions/proofs, stale candidate, or missing joint proof; task completions alone cannot accept, and distinct shell commands are not guessed equivalent.
acceptance_map.design_element: acceptance-evidence/v1 separates task completion, contribution edges, accountable criterion owner, several exact proof requirements, and separately required joint integration evidence.
acceptance_map.validation: Public Plan/Build/acceptance supports many-to-many contributions and blocks any missing contribution/proof, stale candidate, absent joint proof, or guessed command equivalence.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Plan gate, Build gate, and aggregate acceptance

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC12 J1: real native start through collection: An authorized supported real host supplies genuine observed start/identity, terminal evidence, and actual collected output through production interfaces. Verification: Record real host/evidence provenance; missing identity/terminal yields exact refusal without fabricated completion or duplicate launch. Unsupported capability is refused before readiness and unverified; simulation or skip cannot satisfy this criterion.
acceptance_map.design_element: J1 drives one authorized fresh real Codex-native dispatch through genuine observed start/identity, terminal, and collected output using phase-host-dispatch/v1.
acceptance_map.validation: Exact real host/evidence provenance is retained; missing identity/terminal or unsupported capability stays unverified and never fabricates completion or duplicates launch.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: fresh real native dispatch and collection

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC13 J2: quality Design to Plan to Build: A fresh execution trace carries actual Design-selected strategy, complete outputs, and quality authority into fresh Plan and Build. Verification: Exercise removed/altered-artifact failure through the same production connection. Label host mode and evidence origin; simulated host tests cannot substitute for J1 or J6.
acceptance_map.design_element: J2 executes fresh Design to Plan to Build using the actual complete stage-handoff/v2 package and quality authority; evidence origin and host mode are explicit.
acceptance_map.validation: The normal production connection passes and removal/alteration of an actual producer artifact blocks the same connection; simulation is not credited to J0/J1/J6.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: fresh Design/Plan/Build journey

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC14 J3: interruption and pickup: Production-entry traces cover owner/reviewer roles and applicable phases, fresh pickup, duplicate events, cancellation, and interruption, preserving logical operation identity. Verification: Inject faults at relevant persistence/effect boundaries and assert readiness records, launch counts, uncertain effects, and explicit real/simulated labels for each trace.
acceptance_map.design_element: J3 parameterizes the shared lifecycle over owner/reviewer, applicable phases, fresh pickup, interruption, cancellation, duplicate/out-of-order events, and every persistence/effect fault while retaining one operation identity.
acceptance_map.validation: Each real/simulated-labeled trace asserts readiness records, effect state, and launch counts; changed input and unavailable reconciliation refuse.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: phase start/pickup/reconcile

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC15 J4: rejected review and bounded correction: Production collection refuses pass-with-blocker and progresses only through a bounded authorized correction to a corrected candidate with sufficient current evidence. Verification: Verify unchanged failure preserves identity/completed work and stops blind retries; retain correction authority, real/simulated labels, and unresolved evidence gaps.
acceptance_map.design_element: J4 rejects a reported pass with a canonical blocker, issues only one current bounded correction authorization, and admits only the corrected candidate with sufficient evidence.
acceptance_map.validation: Unchanged failure retains attempt/completed work and ends automatic retries; correction authority, host mode, and unresolved gaps remain explicit.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: review collection, correction, and gate

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC16 J5: multiple tasks and proofs: An actual Plan-produced many-to-many/multiple-proof package reaches Build and aggregate acceptance with joint behavior evidence. Verification: Delete each required contribution/proof or change candidate identity and require the same journey to block; no fixture rewrites the producer package to bypass checks, and mode is labeled.
acceptance_map.design_element: J5 carries an actual Plan-produced multi-task/multi-criterion contribution graph, several proof identities, and joint behavior evidence into Build and aggregate acceptance.
acceptance_map.validation: Deleting any contribution/proof/joint binding or changing candidate identity blocks the same journey without rewriting the producer package.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Plan to Build to aggregate acceptance

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC17 J6: real finalization: On a supported real host, production Build output provides full accessible evidence to fresh Evaluate, independent Engineering review, applicable scoped human sign-off, Retro, and the declared Release/Publish/final outcome. Verification: Missing downstream evidence/authority blocks at its boundary. Prove PR-based delivery and separately authorized publication; Build-only results, documents, synthetic terminals, old approval, or skips cannot satisfy the journey.
acceptance_map.design_element: J6 carries current production Build output on a supported real host through fresh Evaluate, independent Engineering, applicable scoped human sign-off, Retro, protected-main PR delivery, and separate publication authorization using exact tested bytes. A valid sealed terminal-wave-metrics receipt is a mechanical prerequisite for Retro, final sign-off, J6, and finalization.
acceptance_map.validation: Each missing evidence/authority boundary blocks; Build-only, documents, synthetic terminals, old approval, skip, rebuild, or direct push cannot satisfy finalization. Missing, stale, malformed, foreign, or reconstructed telemetry blocks before Retro and remains blocking through publication.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Build terminalization through declared Release/Publish outcome

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC18 Authority and retained obligations: All supported paths distinguish draft/interrupted output, mechanical validity, and attributed progression authority under the explicit applicable policy; recovery rechecks recorded scope-valid authorization. Verification: Reject predecessor conversations/runtime, old Design/Plan/approvals/reviews/completion claims, and stale fingerprints as current authority. Retain R-0001/R-0003 dependencies; keep P14 native canary and P23 whole-suite adjudication separately open. R-0004 remains historical only because its applicable obligations are incorporated into R-0001.
acceptance_map.design_element: The approval policy distinguishes draft, mechanical validity, stage consumability, independent review, human sign-off, reuse, correction, release preparation, and publication; historical revalidation is append-only and retained obligations remain open.
acceptance_map.validation: Predecessor runtime/conversation, old Design/Plan/approval/review/completion, copied authentication, and stale fingerprints never authorize progression; active R-0001/R-0003 and P14/P23 remain visible, while R-0004 remains historical only.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: all stage gates, reuse, recovery, and finalization

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC19 Modest reuse and bounded migration: Each proposed unit maps one responsibility and explicit inputs/outputs to incumbent capabilities and acceptance checks. Each bounded migration PR names superseded inactive/removed paths, compatibility, and rollback. Verification: Add a phase via definition/processing/domain validation using existing capabilities without shared dispatch/pickup/storage/hook/lifecycle changes; review rejects competing owners, unexplained infrastructure, or silent historical-authority reinterpretation.
acceptance_map.design_element: The shared phase-agent runtime (agent-runtime/v1) and declarative phase-definition/v1 make extension a data-plus-skill change. One explicitly thin taskplane/agent_runtime.py facade composes incumbent owners and is not changed per phase.
acceptance_map.validation: The positive selector adds one closed-DAG phase definition and skill, runs the loop, and proves the diff touches only settings/agents/<name>.*, skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and its test, except an explicitly registered domain validator. Dispatch/result/evaluation/gate/handoff/continuation bind the definition-set, phase-definition, skill-content, validator-inventory, artifact-schema-version, and capability-set fingerprints. The severed selector independently refuses singular successor; missing/ambiguous predecessors, successors, edge_conditions, entry, or terminal; agent-authored DAG/evaluation/gate fields; changed skill bytes; changed validator identity/inventory; consumed/produced schema mismatch; missing/changed capability set; per-agent Python; or shared runtime/dispatch/pickup/storage/hook/lifecycle edits.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Design/Plan conformance and phase extension fixture

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC20 Honest telemetry and privacy: Record run/phase/attempt/operation/candidate identity, continuation, timing, actual terminal outcome, last progress/wait, correction/replay counts, uncertain effects, missing evidence, and next permitted action. Verification: Replay/duplicate-event cases count attempts/provider usage once; usage has provenance/cache semantics, unavailable stays unavailable, and exported diagnostics omit secrets, full prompts, transcripts, and predecessor private runtime.
acceptance_map.design_element: phase-progress receipts and portable telemetry use low-cardinality allowlisted fields, one logical observation identity for attempt/usage counting, explicit source/cache semantics, unavailable nulls, retention ownership, and downstream minimization/deletion receipts. wave_metrics owns a sealed terminal receipt that downstream stages consume without recounting. Agent definition, consumed knowledge, proposed/admitted/rejected knowledge updates, lifecycle API attempts, evaluator lens-set identity, and nonce-hook observation are low-cardinality typed signals.
acceptance_map.validation: Replay/duplicates count once; injected secrets, prompts, transcripts, private paths/runtime, identities, free-form payloads, and copied authority are rejected from every portable output; unavailable never becomes zero. Retro may not reconstruct or seal from projections; it consumes the current terminal receipt or refuses. A Retro emitted without the current run-bound terminal receipt remains unsealed; knowledge proposal/apply and retention receipts obey the same portable allowlist and forbidden-field rules. Definition/DAG, closed-result, CAS/replay, nonce/evaluator, lease/deadline/fence/retry, and configured/consumed/remaining budget signals are bounded and alert on every blocked authority/effect transition.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: status, diagnostics, Retro, and final evidence export

acceptance_map.criterion: FP-AC21 Fresh Product and Design handoff: The manual spec/intake are the only current Product deliverables, with no canonical registration or approval. Later authorized registration retains scope; former Design/Plan remain historical. Verification: Review the artifacts for complete original-criterion/journey mappings and no claimed code/runtime/Git/authority mutation. Fresh Design must bind source, assign exact owned positive/negative selectors, and settle policy/compatibility/rollout before applicable gates.
acceptance_map.design_element: This Design is freshly bound to R-0001, current source/decomposition/graph/candidate/team, all 21 criteria, exact owned positive/severed selectors, explicit authority policy, compatibility, rollout, rollback, and dependency-ordered slices; former R-0002 artifacts are history only.
acceptance_map.validation: Artifact review and gate reject any stale requirement/candidate/team/graph/selector binding or claimed Product/code/runtime/Git/approval mutation.
acceptance_map.public_entrypoint: Design gate and human approval presentation

journeys.title: Fresh clone and empty home to small real completion
journeys.entry: clean supported installation plus attributable initial and consolidated implementation authorization
journeys.operator_intervention: No manual filesystem edits, receipt injection, CLI repair, relaunch, state mutation, or evidence fabrication after authorization. Explicit human policy gates are supplied as bound input receipts and are not operator repair.
journeys.actual_output_rule: Mode-conditional actual producer rule: S0-S2 consume actual outputs through the incumbent Taskplane 2.19.0 public lifecycle/RunStore/delivery-observation dispatch-and-collection/stage-handoff/evaluator-finalization boundary; S3-S6 consume actual outputs through phase-definition/v1 plus agent-runtime/v1 and its incumbent ports. No fixture, predecessor runtime, cross-mode substitution, or missing producer output may satisfy either mode.
journeys.blocking_rule: Any operator repair, removed/bypassed shared mechanism component, nonconforming phase output, degraded host, or missing telemetry seal prevents completion.
journeys.baseline: S0 records J0 green on the installed Taskplane 2.19.0 baseline before any product slice lands.
journeys.slice_regression_gate: Every S1-S6 exit requires a fresh candidate-bound proof of the same J0 invariant in the slice's declared implementation mode; skip, xfail, operator repair, degraded host, fixture substitution, or a severed mode-specific shared boundary blocks the slice.
journeys.invariant: From a fresh clone and empty home, one small real requirement reaches the same declared terminal outcome without operator repair, fabricated output, skipped shared boundary, degraded evidence, or missing telemetry seal.
journeys.incumbent_shared_boundary: Installed Taskplane 2.19.0 public lifecycle -> RunStore pickup/recovery -> delivery-port/producer-observation dispatch and collection -> stage handoff -> evaluator/finalization path.
journeys.runtime_shared_boundary: phase-definition/v1 -> agent-runtime/v1 -> incumbent RunStore/delivery/observation/review ports -> closed stage-handoff/v2 -> evaluator/finalization path.
journeys.mode_equivalence: Both modes bind the same fresh user input, requirement/candidate, declared outcome, actual producer lineage, real-supported-host evidence class, attributable gate set, no-intervention rule, telemetry seal, and public refusal behavior.
journeys.severance_scope: agent-runtime removal or bypass is a valid negative only for S3-S6. S0-S2 instead remove or bypass one corresponding incumbent lifecycle/dispatch/collection component and require the same visible journey failure rather than a skip.
a1_1_obligations: actual sole phase-definition registry and DAG
all phases through the thin non-authoritative runtime
closed result envelope at every phase
knowledge proposal/apply CAS receipts where proposed
effect-free retry or reconciled higher-fence replacement

journeys.blocking_rule: Neither stable host events nor valid Taskplane nonce hook receipts may be missing; degraded observation remains unverified.
actual producer package must cross the production boundary

journeys.entry: S2 recovery and S4 host transport
journeys.blocking_rule: uncertain effects require reconciliation; changed input refuses
reported pass never overrides a blocker and correction never implies progression
task completion alone cannot establish requirement acceptance

journeys.entry: all prior slices and current J1 proof
journeys.blocking_rule: Build-only, synthetic, skipped, rebuilt, stale-authority, or direct-push paths are ineligible

journeys.title: Source coverage through realized conformance
journeys.actual_output_rule: Each consumer receives the exact actual upstream producer output through the public boundary.
journeys.blocking_rule: Any stale/fabricated/missing output or any independently severed seam blocks the terminal conformance result.
a1_1_obligations: each producer/result binds the same definition-set and candidate
stage-handoff/v2 is closed at each phase boundary
knowledge fingerprint changes are explicit changed inputs
retry never hides a severed or uncertain-effect edge
fixture-bypass review verifies actual producer lineage
journeys.entry: S3 phase-definition, agent-runtime facade, stage-handoff/v2, source coverage, and seam manifest

risks.risk: A second phase registry or DAG silently diverges from phase-definition/v1
risks.mitigation: Make the candidate-bound definition set the sole registry, bind its fingerprint through every receipt, reject duplicate/cyclic/ambiguous/unreachable definitions, and fail review on any hardcoded phase list or edge table.

risks.risk: The runtime facade gains reverse imports or progression authority
risks.mitigation: Enforce loop/adapters -> facade -> injected incumbent ports/pure validators; prohibit incumbent/skill reverse imports, journals, phase switches, gates, successors, and progression branches.

risks.risk: Concurrent or replayed knowledge apply loses, duplicates, or leaks state
risks.mitigation: Proposal/apply split, base-fingerprint CAS, current fencing token, byte-identical exact replay, no partial writes, and sealed retention/deletion/minimization receipts.

risks.risk: Nonce identity or evaluator input leaks authority or agent-private state
risks.mitigation: Bind the full attempt/package/definition/knowledge/deadline tuple, export only nonce digest, keep degraded mode non-creditable, and exclude working lenses, nonce secret, lifecycle capability, and mutable knowledge from evaluator input.

risks.risk: Lease expiry or retry overlaps a prior effect and produces duplicate writes
risks.mitigation: Expiry never means cancellation; same-attempt retry requires no effects/effect-free proof, replacement requires reconciliation plus higher fence, and unfenceable boundaries remain blocked until authoritative terminal/non-overlap proof.

risks.risk: Heartbeat, deadline, retry, or evidence cardinality exhausts operational budgets
risks.mitigation: Bind token/wall/attempt/correction/heartbeat/telemetry budgets from definitions and canonical settings, alert before expiry/exhaustion, and return a terminal recoverable refusal with no lock.

risks.risk: loop.py becomes a new policy-owning god module
risks.mitigation: Keep validation, persistence, host, finding, acceptance, and release policy in incumbent owners; loop only sequences typed receipts.

risks.risk: A migration temporarily creates two active progression owners
risks.mitigation: Use dual-read/single-write cutovers with an explicit inactive superseded writer before the next slice.

risks.risk: Historical bytes are silently reinterpreted as current authority
risks.mitigation: Preserve originals, use deterministic adapters plus append-only revalidation, and require explicit scope-valid reuse authority.

risks.risk: A self-consistent forged path, receipt, selector, or host event crosses a privileged boundary
risks.mitigation: Canonicalize paths and symlinks, validate schemas/identity/provenance, use unforgeable scoped capabilities, and recheck authority before effects/recovery.

risks.risk: Real-host evidence is deferred until simulation-only work has accumulated
risks.mitigation: Run the J1 capability/identity/start/terminal/collection spike in S0 and stop on an unsupported capability gap.

risks.risk: Fixture-created predecessor outputs conceal a broken production connection
risks.mitigation: Boundary and journey proofs must consume actual producer outputs and pair each positive with a targeted one-edge severance.

risks.risk: Recovery duplicates external work or destroys completed work
risks.mitigation: Retain operation identity, reconcile uncertain effects before relaunch, cap retries, and hold on repeated unchanged failure.

risks.risk: Telemetry or durable artifacts leak sensitive runtime data
risks.mitigation: Positive portable allowlists, forbidden-field rejection, pseudonymous run-scoped identity, minimized immutable evidence, retention/deletion receipts, and no prompts/transcripts/copied authority.

risks.risk: Traversal, worker waves, retry, evidence, or telemetry cardinality becomes unbounded
risks.mitigation: Bind all limits to canonical settings, record exact stop reasons, cap Design workers at sixteen, deduplicate observations, and use indexed candidate reads.

risks.risk: Release evidence is green while real native finalization is missing
risks.mitigation: J6 requires current J1 evidence, exact tested package bytes, fresh downstream stages, independent Engineering, scoped sign-off, protected-main receipts, and separate publication authority.

risks.risk: Compound negative cases mask one another under one selector result
risks.mitigation: Require named pytest parameter IDs and one collected/executed/outcome receipt per case; missing case receipts make the proof incomplete.

risks.risk: Tests fabricate producer artifacts yet pass review as end-to-end proof
risks.mitigation: Run changed-test fixture-bypass AST/dataflow review and require actual producer-call/artifact provenance; unit fixtures are labeled and ineligible.

risks.risk: Retro or finalization proceeds without truthful delivery metrics
risks.mitigation: Make the sealed terminal-wave-metrics receipt a mechanical prerequisite for Retro, final sign-off, J6, and finalization.

risks.risk: Landing expansion is coupled to unfinished lower-priority work
risks.mitigation: Land S0-S2 as a separately approved foundation, then require a fresh S3 revalidation for S3-S6 while preserving independent rollback.

risks.risk: agent_runtime.py becomes a second loop.py
risks.mitigation: Keep it a package-in/result-out facade over incumbent owners; prohibit policy, persistence, progression, and hardcoded phase ordering; enforce import-cycle and one-owner review.

risks.risk: A skill instructs its phase agent to call lifecycle operations
risks.mitigation: Expose no lifecycle tools; refuse the attempted call before effect as lifecycle_api_attempt and surface a high substantive finding.

risks.risk: A phase agent influences its own evaluation lenses
risks.mitigation: Make evaluation_lenses orchestrator-authority, ignore/refuse agent-produced copies, and exclude working-lens configuration from the evaluator package.

risks.risk: Knowledge updates encode gate-passing strategy or cross scope
risks.mitigation: knowledge-update/v1 rejects gate-conditioned, unreferenced, free-form strategy, forbidden-field, and cross-scope content; admission remains gated and provenance-bearing.

risks.risk: Knowledge fingerprint drift breaks deterministic replay
risks.mitigation: Bind the exact knowledge fingerprint into the sealed package and operation; a changed fingerprint is changed input and is refused under the same operation identity.

risks.risk: Per-agent Python and shared-mechanism edits creep into phase extension
risks.mitigation: FP-AC19 constrains the positive diff to definition, skill, and tests; only enumerated registered domain validators are exceptions, and shared runtime edits fail review.

failure_modes.mode: Phase registry/DAG is duplicate, cyclic, unreachable, ambiguous, stale, foreign, or agent-mutated
failure_modes.detection: phase-definition validation or receipt binding differs before dispatch.
failure_modes.recovery: Refuse without effects; correct the sole definition set, issue a new fingerprint/binding, and rerun J0/FP-AC19.

failure_modes.mode: Runtime import direction or non-authoritative boundary is violated
failure_modes.detection: Import/ownership review finds a reverse edge, second journal, phase switch, gate, successor, or progression branch.
failure_modes.recovery: Block the slice, remove the authority/edge, restore the incumbent owner, and rerun architecture plus J0 boundary proof.

failure_modes.mode: Knowledge proposal conflicts, replays with changed bytes, uses a stale fence, or partially writes
failure_modes.detection: knowledge apply validation/CAS/seal reports stale base, changed replay, gate/fence mismatch, or current/new fingerprint inconsistency.
failure_modes.recovery: Write nothing, preserve the finding, return current fingerprint and fresh-package continuation; exact replay returns the original sealed receipt.

failure_modes.mode: Closed runtime result is incomplete, open-ended, duplicated, or carries more than one continuation
failure_modes.detection: agent-runtime/stage-handoff validation lacks required bindings, terminal/effect truth, produces validation, or a single continuation.
failure_modes.recovery: Return a typed terminal refusal; reconcile observations and correct collection under current attempt authority without fabricating output.

failure_modes.mode: Lease expires or a retry/replacement is attempted with unresolved effects or stale fencing
failure_modes.detection: Heartbeat/deadline receipt, effect state, and writer fence show uncertain ownership, same-attempt post-effect retry, or non-increasing replacement fence.
failure_modes.recovery: Stop new effects, reconcile the original operation, then retry only if effect-free or issue a higher-fenced replacement; unfenceable boundaries wait for authoritative terminal proof.

rollout.rollback: Rollback remains branch- and slice-scoped. Expansion rollback preserves accepted C/E foundation; foundation rollback invalidates expansion authority. Any J0 regression blocks landing and triggers rollback before the next slice.

knowledge_governance.input: Knowledge is read-only in-run and enters only as a scoped content-addressed artifact in the sealed package. Identical inputs include the exact knowledge fingerprint; a changed fingerprint is a changed operation input.
knowledge_governance.admission: The declared domain validator validates the proposal; only the phase's canonical gate may admit it. The incumbent knowledge-store owner appends admitted updates and emits the new fingerprint.
knowledge_governance.forbidden: In-run writes, self-modification, mutable shared memory, cross-scope reads, and silent update drops are forbidden. A rejected update becomes a finding while otherwise conforming phase outputs remain independently admissible.
knowledge_governance.proposal_apply_split: Agents emit only knowledge-update proposals. The orchestrator applies an admitted proposal through the incumbent knowledge owner after evaluation and gate.
knowledge_governance.cas_replay: Apply is compare-and-swap on the consumed base fingerprint with current writer fence; exact replay returns the same sealed knowledge-apply receipt and changed input refuses.
knowledge_governance.conflict_recovery: CAS conflict writes nothing, reports the current fingerprint, and requires a fresh sealed package; it never retries by last-write-wins.
knowledge_governance.retention_and_sealing: Apply, rejection, conflict, deletion, and minimization emit sealed receipts. Retention preserves audit fingerprints while excluding forbidden content.

design_question_addenda.DQ-01: The human_gates table is the single source: Product initial authorization, Design consolidated pre-implementation authorization, mechanical Plan/Build/Evaluate, attributable Engineering sign-off, telemetry-gated Retro, separate Release publication, plus explicit foundation/expansion delivery authorizations. Legacy duplicate Design/Plan gates are ceremonial projections only.
design_question_addenda.DQ-02: Real host observation prefers stable host events, then Taskplane-owned per-attempt nonce hook receipts, then explicit degraded observation with human Product rescope or capability repair. No transcript parsing or simulated credit.
design_question_addenda.DQ-05: All seven work phases are stateless agents on one shared thin runtime; definitions and skills specialize behavior, the orchestrator owns continuation and evaluator lenses, and knowledge is a sealed input plus gated provenance-bearing update.

lens_refresh.amendment: A1 phase agents/shared runtime/governed knowledge/explicit gates
lens_refresh.rule: Existing result files and fingerprints are preserved as historical input but cannot evidence the merged content. Fresh lens results must be produced against the provisional merged content fingerprint before final lens synthesis or Design approval.
lens_refresh.unaffected_dispositions: stand unless a required rerun raises a new positive signal

phase_definition_contract.loading: The orchestrator loads and validates an ordered versioned set and sequences from definitions; loop.py hardcodes no phase list.
phase_definition_contract.unknown_fields: Reject unknown required fields. Unknown optional non-authority fields follow v1 compatibility policy.
phase_definition_contract.authority_rule: Only orchestrator-loaded definitions may supply authority fields; agent-produced copies are ignored for authority and emitted as refusal findings.
phase_definition_contract.binding_rule: The definition-set and selected phase-definition fingerprints, skill content fingerprint, validator identities and inventory fingerprint, consumed/produced artifact schema versions, and capability-set fingerprint bind dispatch, runtime result, evaluation, gate, handoff, and continuation; any second registry/DAG, singular successor, missing/ambiguous DAG field, changed skill bytes, changed validator inventory, artifact schema mismatch, unavailable/changed capability set, or stale binding refuses before effects.

agent_runtime_contract.budget_exhaustion: Terminal refusal with effect state and phase-pickup-result/v1 continuation; never a lock.
agent_runtime_contract.ownership_boundary: Thin facade composes incumbents and owns no policy, persistence, phase ordering, gate, continuation, or progression.
agent_runtime_contract.closed_result: Exactly one accepted candidate envelope or typed terminal refusal binds definition/package/knowledge/authority/nonce/lease/fence/deadline/budget and one continuation.
agent_runtime_contract.strict_import_direction: loop/phase adapters import agent_runtime; agent_runtime imports only injected incumbent ports and pure validators; incumbents, skills, and definitions never import runtime internals.
agent_runtime_contract.effect_retry: Retry is same-attempt only before effects or when proven effect-free; effectful replacement requires a higher fence and completed reconciliation, with unfenceable boundaries blocked until authoritative terminal proof.
